title: By His Own Account
dek: Is he profiting from the office? His own financial disclosure answers most of it: what came in during his first year back, where it came from, and who was paying.

title: The Ballroom
dek: Who is paying for the president's ballroom, and what have they gotten since? The donors, the public money, the contracts, and a court fight the Supreme Court paused without deciding.

title: Paid For
dek: Is public money being used to promote the president himself? Banners of his face, an app on federal phones, a 24-hour stream and a TV ad with a government disclaimer: what each cost and who paid.

title: Shut Out
dek: Trump banned three news organizations from the White House. Six days later a judge he appointed ordered them back in. The claims, the record, and what comes next.
